title: Cowboy Butter Chicken Pasta
ingredients: ½ cup reserved pasta water (as needed)
instructions: Season cubed chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 6–8 minutes until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
Boil a pot of salted water and cook bowtie pasta until al dente. Reserve ½ cup pasta water before draining.
In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in Kinder's Cowboy Butter seasoning and heavy cream. Simmer 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in grated parmesan until smooth and melted.
Add chicken back to the skillet. Add drained pasta and toss to coat. Add a splash of pasta water if the sauce needs thinning.
notes: Creator Brittney Kingsmore Bolt describes this as 'creamy chicken Alfredo but with tomato paste and Kinder's Cowboy Butter seasoning.' She says it's the best thing she made all year and puts it straight in the dinner rotation.
